name: Field
summary: The scaffolding around a control: a label, the control itself, and a line of text that says what to do next. It owns the spacing, so a form does not have to.
summaryZh: 控件外面的骨架:标签、控件本身,以及一条说明下一步做什么的文字。间距由它负责,表单就不用自己排。

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default control height. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

states.name: Error
states.note: The message takes the danger text colour, and a control inside the field gets a danger border.

states.name: Success
states.note: The message takes the success text colour.

states.name: Warning
states.note: The message takes the warning text colour.

states.name: Info
states.note: The message takes the info text colour.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field's own text dims. The control inside is the host's to disable, because it is the element that can be switched off.

states.name: Inline
states.note: The label sits beside the control instead of above it.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The label above the control. It is a real <label>, so it needs a for that matches the control's id.

parts.name: Message
parts.note: The helper or error text below the control. It is muted until the field is in its error state.

props.name: error
props.description: Puts the field in its error state.

props.name: validate-status
props.description: Which validation state the field is in. It is the class the state is painted with: um-field--error, um-field--success, um-field--warning or um-field--info.
props.descriptionZh: 表单项处于哪个校验状态。它就是那个状态对应的类:um-field--error、um-field--success、um-field--warning 或 um-field--info。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Says the field is out of use. The field's own text dims. The control inside is the host's to disable, because it is the element that can actually be switched off.
props.descriptionZh: 表示这个表单项不再使用。表单项自己的文字会变暗。里面的控件由宿主来禁用,因为它才是真正能被关掉的元素。

props.name: inline
props.description: Puts the label beside the control instead of above it.
props.descriptionZh: 把标签放在控件旁边,而不是上面。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the control the field holds. The field does not redraw the control — it only tells it how tall it is. The medium size is the control's own size already.
props.descriptionZh: 表单项里那个控件的尺寸。表单项不重画控件,只告诉它有多高。中号就是控件本来的高度。

slots.name: label
slots.description: The label text, above the control.

slots.name: message
slots.description: The helper or error text, below the control.
slots.descriptionZh: 控件下方的帮助或错误说明。

a11y.notes: The field is a plain container; the accessibility work is done by the label and the control. Use a real <label for> that points at the control's id, and aria-describedby when the message carries something the user needs to hear. The library paints the error state but does not announce it — that is the host's job.
a11y.notesZh: 表单项本身只是一个容器,可访问性由标签和控件承担。用真正的 <label for> 指向控件的 id,消息里有用户必须听到的信息时再加上 aria-describedby。库负责画出错误态,不负责播报 —— 播报是宿主的事。

examples.title: Layout
examples.description: A label, a control and a message. The field owns the gaps between them, so nothing here needs a margin of its own.
examples.descriptionZh: 标签、控件、说明三段。间距由表单项负责,这三样自己都不需要写 margin。
examples.markup: The name other people will see.

examples.title: Error
examples.description: The error modifier reaches into the control: the border of the input, textarea or select inside the field turns to the danger colour, and the message stops being muted. The message is text, so it takes the derived danger text colour rather than the raw danger fill.
examples.descriptionZh: 错误修饰类会作用到控件:里面输入框、文本域或选择器的描边变成危险色,说明文字也不再是灰的。说明文字是文字,所以用的是派生出来的危险色文字,而不是危险的填充色。
examples.markup: Enter a valid email address.

notes: The field is a wrapper rather than a class you put on the control, because the control has to stay the element the platform knows about — a real input, a real select. The error modifier is the only state the field owns; the label and the message are muted roles, not a second theming system.
notesZh: 表单项做成外层容器,而不是一个贴在控件上的类,因为控件必须还是平台认识的那个元素 —— 一个真正的 input、一个真正的 select。错误修饰类是表单项唯一拥有的状态;标签和说明都是弱化的文字角色,不是第二套配色。
